summary: Identity confirmed at 20120 Lakeview Center Plaza. The current complete official food surface explicitly maps 58 canonical products. All 88 frozen rows reconcile once (58 exact products, 30 headings/event cards/social controls/description fragments). All four allergen searches are complete; no formal matrix exists. Positive-only official ingredient evidence and GF presentation labels are preserved without unsupported absence or cross-contact claims.
proposedChanges: Publish only canonical dishes/accompaniments from the complete official menu and remove headings, event cards, controls, and description fragments.
Preserve source presentation labels and positive ingredient evidence; do not interpret GF labels as universal allergen-free or cross-contact-safe.
